title: Agent decision envelope
description: docs/protocol.md section 11. The single JSON object a policy returns. This schema is structural validation only: whether the decision is economically permitted is the policy signer's job (MandateValidator), and whether it is legal is the contract's. Keeping the three separate is ADR-006. Note what is absent: sessionId, configHash, sequence, actor address and validUntil. The controller supplies those from validated state, and a model that could set them could sign a trade in another session.

decision.description: Exactly one action. `oneOf` rather than `anyOf`: an object matching two branches is a malformed decision, not a permissive one.

explanation.description: Operator-facing self-report. Never sent to the counterparty, never on-chain, never in an observation. Displayed labelled as the agent's own account of its reasoning, which is not evidence of it.

quote_amount_minor.description: Positive integer in minor units, as a base-10 string with no leading zeros, no sign, no decimal point and no exponent. A string because a JSON number would be a float in most parsers and a price is exact.

offer_hash.description: Must equal the active offer digest in the observation. A digest that does not is an invalid decision, not a different trade.

reason.description: docs/protocol.md section 10, participant close codes 1..3 by name. The agent's statement, not a verified fact.
